snippet.title: MiRuRi: Mahou Fuku Bouken Trailer - Game for Windows PC
snippet.description:
Just the trailer to my second game.

It's an anime style comedy adventure game.

It can be found and downloaded on Itch or Gamejolt, links below (need to remove the space after https://)

https:// sirlothus01.itch.io/miruri-mahou-fuku-bouken
https:// gamejolt.com/games/miruri/942124

Have a nice day!
